ws.claude_full_write: Guidance only — full permission has a command tool (Bash), so it can write outside the folders
ws.claude_full_read: Guidance only — full permission can read other folders with commands
ws.claude_write: Enforced — can only edit inside the work folder and shared (write) folders; can't edit shared (read-only) or anything else (Claude --restricted)
ws.claude_read: Enforced — can't read outside the work folder and attached shared folders (no command tool)
ws.cell_write: The engine cell container is the boundary — can't write outside the cell; between folders inside the cell it's guidance only
ws.cell_read: Guidance only — can also read other folders inside the cell
ws.codex_full_write: Guidance only — full permission has commands and internet open
ws.codex_new_write: Enforced (Codex sandbox, runs without approval) — can't write outside the work folder and shared (write) folders
ws.other_read: Guidance only — this staff member can also read other folders
ws.cell_codex_write: The engine cell container is the boundary — can't write outside the cell; between folders inside the cell it's guidance only (file edits are asked via approval cards)
ws.codex_write: Only when allowed — in work mode, a card asks each time a file is edited. Outside the work folder the card is marked "outside work folder", and it's written if you allow it
ws.guide_only: Guidance only — Ieon only gives instructions
ws.session_write: Guidance only — the session's own settings apply; Ieon only tells it about the folders

channel.instructions:
User questions arrive through the Ieon (ieon) connector in <channel source="ieon" chat_id="ieon" message_id="..."> tags.
The person asking sees the Ieon screen, not this terminal. Always send your answer with the reply tool, putting that message_id in reply_to.
If it seems you need a tool other than reply or need to change files, don't do it; say so with reply.
channel.reply_desc: Sends an answer to an Ieon question. Put the question's message_id in reply_to.
channel.bad_reply_to: reply_to is not an Ieon question ID
channel.already_replied: Already answered this question, so not sending again
voice_live.instructions: You are Ieon's voice interpreter, relaying between a person and the work session '{name}'. You know nothing about this work, code or project. Never make anything up about the work: for any question or request about it, call the ask_session tool with the person's words as they said them (don't change the meaning). After sending, briefly say something like 'I asked the session, waiting for the answer.' When a system message starting with 'SESSION ANSWER' arrives, summarize that answer in English in 1-3 sentences and mention the full answer is on the screen. When 'SESSION RESULT' or 'APPROVAL NEEDED' arrives, briefly explain the situation. Never approve or allow anything by voice; tell the person to press the button on the screen card. Use check_status when they ask about progress and stop_request when they ask to stop. Always speak briefly and naturally in English.
voice_live.tool_ask: Send the person's question or request to the work session as is. Use this for anything about the work, code or project.
voice_live.tool_ask_q: The person's words as they said them (meaning unchanged)
voice_live.tool_status: Check the status of the question that was sent.
voice_live.tool_stop: Stop the question being processed (only when the person asks to stop).
